content.text:
=== admin login page SSO link ===
HTTP:200
href="/admin/login/start"
=== find any form actions / button links ===
<a href="/admin/login/start"

observation.command:
cd /tmp/nebu-validate; mkdir -p adm; cd adm
echo "=== admin login page SSO link ==="
curl -sS -m 10 -c a_cookies.txt -o a_login.html -w 'HTTP:%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:8080/admin/login
grep -oE '(href|data-url)="[^"]*"' a_login.html | grep -iE 'sso|oidc|signin|login' | head -5
echo "=== find any form actions / button links ==="
grep -oE '<(form|a)[^>]*(action|href)="[^"]*"' a_login.html | head -10
